resume_tips: Highlight relevant coursework or projects in data engineering
Emphasize any experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP)
Showcase familiarity with data processing tools and frameworks

Mention teamwork or collaborative projects that demonstrate problem-solving skills
red_flags: Preference for candidates currently enrolled in a relevant degree program
